notes: Not automated: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] If you have a total of 4 or less cards in your Life area and hand, draw 1 card. If you have a Character with a cost of 8 or more, you may add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards instead of drawing 1 card.
